verdict.rationale: Cooley GO ships web-based document generators, so a programmatic API is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence documents a public API: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes and llms.txt all returned 404, and the Cooley AI materials describe internal, firm-owned tooling rather than a customer-facing API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
